title: Application of Cambridge Electric Light Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 338, for approval by the Department of Public Utiliteis of a reduction in the quarterly Power Cost Charge to be billed to the Comany's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing month of June. The Power Cost Charge reflects change in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
